paragraphs.text: Cory J. Herndon is an author and a former Associate Editor for The Duelist and TopDeck . He worked for Wizards of the Coast from January 1998 to August 2001. He lives in Southern California with his wife, author S.P. Miskowski .

Herdon has written or co-written several novels and short stories in the Magic: The Gathering line, including the finale of the Mirrodin Cycle , the entirety of the Ravnica Cycle , and (with Scott McGough ) the Lorwyn novels (plus one novella). His first book for Dungeons & Dragons , The Living Dead , was written under the pseudonym T.H. Lain . He has edited, designed, and written material for pen-and-paper roleplaying games, including the original Star Wars D20 RPG book Ultimate Alien Anthology .
